'''Christopher Ashley Cullis''' has been Francis Hobart Herrick Professor of Biology at [[Case Western Reserve University]] since 1994.<ref>{{cite web |title=Christopher Cullis |url=https://biology.case.edu/faculty/christopher-cullis/ |website=[[Case Western Reserve University]] |access-date=14 January 2026}}</ref><ref name="cv">{{cite web |title=curriculum vitae |url=https://case.edu/artsci/biol/people/CullisCV.pdf |website=Case Western Reserve University |access-date=14 January 2026}}</ref>

He completed a BSc from the [[University of London]] (as an external student at [[University of Zimbabwe|University College of Rhodesia]]).<ref name="cv"/> He graduated from the [[University of East Anglia]] with an MSc in biophysics in 1968 and a PhD in genetics in 1971.<ref name="cv"/>

He has an [[h-index]] of 47 according to [[Google Scholar]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Chris Cullis |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=tJCfzcEAAAAJ&hl=en |website=[[Google Scholar]] |access-date=14 January 2026}}</ref>
